title: EDUCATION AND GEOGRAPH
de_requirements:
In addition to meeting the minimum O’ Level requirements, Direct Entry candidates into 200 Level must meet any of the following conditions:

-       Two (2) A Level passes in Geography and other relevant subject OR Two merit passes in Geography and one other subject at NCE Level.

-       Candidates without Geography at A Level, but with credit pass in Geography at O’ Level may be considered but must still have another A Level pass in one Social Science or Science.

-       Holders of OND in Urban and Regional Planning, Town Planning, Cartography, Environmental/Science Management, Meteorology, Transport and Logistics Studies/Management, Hospitality and Tourism Management, Geoinformatics, and Agriculture may be considered for direct entry admission into 200 Level.
utme_requirements: The UTME subjects shall include English Language, Mathematics, and any 2 from Geography, Economics, Government, Biology, Physics, and Chemistry.
subjects: The minimum O’ Level subjects requirements for any of the two programmes shall be 5 credit passes at one or two sittings in SSCE/NECO in English Language, Mathematics, and any other 3 subjects from Science or Social Science.
